cases.sentence: Я слышал шум с небес, он напоминал одновременно шум ___, раскаты сильного грома и звук, который производят арфисты, играющие на своих арфах.
cases.explain: «могучих вод» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: I heard a sound from heaven, like the sound of many waters, and like the sound of a great thunder. The sound which I heard was like that of harpists playing on their harps.

cases.sentence: Я слышал шум с небес, он напоминал одновременно шум могучих вод, раскаты ___ и звук, который производят арфисты, играющие на своих арфах.

cases.translation: I heard a sound from heaven, like the sound of many waters, and like the sound of a great thunder. The sound which I heard was like that of harpists playing on their harps.

cases.sentence: Они поют новую песнь перед троном, перед четырьмя ___ и перед старцами.
cases.explain: «живыми существами» — after the preposition «перед», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: They sing a new song before the throne, and before the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn the song except the one hundred forty-four thousand, those who had been redeemed out of the earth.

cases.sentence: Они были искуплены из всего человечества и освящены как ___ для Бога и Ягненка.
cases.explain: «первые плоды» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: These are those who were not defiled with women, for they are virgins. These are those who follow the Lamb wherever he goes. These were redeemed by Jesus from among men, the first fruits to God and to the Lamb.

cases.sentence: На Его голове был ___, и в руке Он держал острый серп.
cases.explain: «золотой венец» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: I looked, and saw a white cloud, and on the cloud one sitting like a son of man, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.

cases.sentence: На Его голове был золотой венец, и в руке Он держал ___.
cases.explain: «острый серп» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: I looked, and saw a white cloud, and on the cloud one sitting like a son of man, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.

cases.sentence: Потом из ___ вышел еще один ангел, у него тоже в руке был острый серп.
cases.explain: «небесного храма» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven. He also had a sharp sickle.

cases.sentence: Потом из небесного храма вышел еще один ангел, у него тоже в руке был ___.
cases.explain: «острый серп» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven. He also had a sharp sickle.

cases.sentence: Он громко крикнул ангелу, у которого был ___:
cases.explain: «острый серп» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Another angel came out from the altar, he who has power over fire, and he called with a great voice to him who had the sharp sickle, saying, “Send your sharp sickle, and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth, for the earth’s grapes are fully ripe!”
